tagline: A quiet corner for work and words
brief: A personal blog and portfolio that should feel minimal, warm, thoughtful and quietly distinctive.
criteria: Recognisable at 16 px, usable in one colour, suited to an editorial website, and distinct from literal book or pen symbols.

concepts.name: Quiet Nook
concepts.idea: An open architectural corner gives one private dot a place of its own.
rationale: The corner connects directly to the meaning of Nook
The dot introduces a human presence without drawing a person
The simple geometry stays legible as a favicon

recommendation: Quiet Nook is the selected direction: warm, compact and recognisable without relying on a literal blog symbol.
next_steps: Use the orange tile for digital icons and avatars
Use the transparent one-colour master for print and flexible layouts
Keep the prescribed clear space and minimum sizes
